# Session Continuation: Genesis TDD Fix + A2UI Protocol Integration

**Date:** 2026-03-30
**Branch:** main
**Active Plan:** ~/.claude/plans/zazzy-snuggling-corbato.md

## What Was Done This Session

### Completed
- [x] Genesis Engine merged to main (2,367 files)
- [x] Application materials (resume, cover letter, tech summary, interview prep)
- [x] Demo quickstart scripts (verified: 50 episodes, 6 metrics, DPO export)
- [x] Webapp hosting via Tailscale Funnel (live)
- [x] SurrealDB plan traceability schema + PlanGraph client
- [x] 3 plan lifecycle hooks (archive, track-files, track-commits)
- [x] Webapp backend fix (port config, router mounts, fallback physics)
- [x] All Genesis tabs populated (thermo, FLUME, swarm, compound, about)
- [x] Cinematic Genesis cosmogony (void, explosion, particles, settling)
- [x] Narration overlay + browser TTS fallback
- [x] Void click target enlarged with ring affordance

### Still Broken (Verified via Playwright)
1. **"CLICK TO BEGIN" overlaps quote text** — both positioned at bottom of void scene
2. **Cosmogony sidebar visible during void** — should be hidden until animation starts
3. **API 404 spam** — `/api/genesis/cosmogony/set-temperature` called repeatedly but endpoint doesn't exist. FIX: remove the API call, local Landau math handles everything
4. **Sound unpleasant** — Tone.js synth parameters too loud/harsh. Need: reduce volumes 10dB, soften attacks, warmer waveforms (sine not sawtooth)
5. **Narration may not display** — overlay has correct code but user reports it's broken. Debug: add console.log to verify narration.currentText is set

### Files to Fix
| File | Issue |
|------|-------|
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx` | VoidQuote overlaps "click to begin" Html; sidebar should hide during void |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useCosmogony.ts` | Remove set-temperature API call (causes 404 spam) |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useSonification.ts` | Reduce volumes, soften parameters |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/app/genesis/page.tsx` | Verify narration overlay renders |

## Strategic Direction: A2UI + AG-UI Protocol Stack

Full plan at ~/.claude/plans/zazzy-snuggling-corbato.md. Key points:

1. **A2UI**: Define Genesis components as declarative catalog (JSON), making the experience testable by agents
2. **AG-UI**: Replace ad-hoc SSE with typed event streaming
3. **Result**: Cohezion becomes one of first projects implementing MCP + A2A + A2UI + AG-UI (4 of 6 Google agent protocols)

### A2UI Research Needed
- Clone https://github.com/google/A2UI.git
- Study the 18 component primitives
- Map existing React components to A2UI catalog format
- Build renderer bridging A2UI JSON to React Three Fiber

## Services Running
- `cohezion-genesis.service` — Next.js on port 3000 (systemd, enabled)
- `cohezion-api.service` — FastAPI on port 8080 (systemd, enabled)
- Tailscale Funnel — proxying / and /api to the above
- SurrealDB — ports 8000/8001

## Live URLs
- https://frameworkdesktop.tail54eb71.ts.net/
- https://frameworkdesktop.tail54eb71.ts.net/genesis
- https://frameworkdesktop.tail54eb71.ts.net/portfolio

# Plan: Agent Protocol Stack — A2UI + AG-UI Integration + TDD Fix

## Context

Two converging problems:
1. **Immediate:** Sound is broken, narration doesn't work, no tests verify the webapp
2. **Strategic:** Google just released A2UI (declarative agent-driven UI) and a 6-protocol agent stack guide. Cohezion already implements MCP + A2A. Adding A2UI + AG-UI makes us one of the first full-stack agent protocol implementations.

The strategic move solves the immediate problem: A2UI's declarative component catalog makes the Genesis experience **testable by agents** (the component tree is JSON, not opaque WebGL). AG-UI's typed event streaming replaces our ad-hoc SSE/WebSocket mix with a standard protocol.

## What Cohezion Already Has

| Protocol | Status | Implementation |
|----------|--------|---------------|
| MCP | Strong | 41+ tools, cloud-vault-mcp, compound-mcp |
| A2A | In Progress | 7 agents, `/.well-known/agent.json` endpoint |
| A2UI | Gap | Genesis webapp uses React/R3F directly, not declarative |
| AG-UI | Gap | SSE universe stream exists but isn't typed to AG-UI spec |

## Phase 1: Fix What's Broken NOW (TDD, 1 session)

Before protocol integration, fix the broken features. Test-first.

### 1.1 Write Playwright tests using MCP browser tools
Use the Playwright MCP tools we already have to test interactively:
- Navigate to /genesis
- Verify "click to begin" is visible
- Click canvas → verify temperature decreases
- Check for narration text overlay
- Check console for JS errors
- Toggle sound/narration buttons

### 1.2 Fix narration
- Read the current narration overlay code
- Verify `narration.currentText` is being set (add debug logging)
- Fix: the overlay may have wrong z-index or be hidden by canvas
- Test: Playwright checks for visible narration text after click

### 1.3 Fix sound
- Read useSonification.ts cinematic methods
- Problem: likely too loud, wrong frequencies, harsh timbres
- Fix: reduce all volumes by 10dB, soften attack/release, use warmer waveforms
- Test: verify no JS errors when sound is toggled on

### 1.4 Stop API 404 spam
- The set-temperature endpoint doesn't exist — remove the API call
- Local Landau math already handles everything
- Test: zero console errors on genesis page

## Phase 2: A2UI Component Catalog (2-3 sessions)

Define the Genesis experience as a **declarative component catalog** following A2UI spec.

### 2.1 Clone and study A2UI
```bash
git clone https://github.com/google/A2UI.git ~/dev/A2UI
```
Study the 18 component primitives, the JSON schema, and the rendering pipeline.

### 2.2 Define Cohezion's component catalog
Map existing React components to A2UI declarative format:

```json
{
  "catalog": {
    "cohezion-void-sphere": {
      "type": "three-scene",
      "props": ["scale", "glowIntensity", "dustCount"],
      "events": ["onClick"]
    },
    "cohezion-explosion": {
      "type": "three-particles",
      "props": ["particleCount", "phase", "fabricColors"],
      "events": ["onPhaseChange"]
    },
    "cohezion-bloch-sphere": {
      "type": "three-interactive",
      "props": ["theta", "phi", "showTrail"],
      "events": ["onDrag", "onRelease"]
    },
    "cohezion-narration": {
      "type": "overlay-text",
      "props": ["text", "duration", "ttsEnabled"],
      "events": ["onComplete"]
    },
    "cohezion-sound-engine": {
      "type": "audio",
      "props": ["phase", "coherence", "temperature", "muted"],
      "events": ["onPhaseTransition"]
    }
  }
}
```

### 2.3 Genesis Experience Script
Replace imperative GenesisScene.tsx with a **declarative timeline**:

```json
{
  "experience": "genesis-cosmogony",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "id": "void",
      "duration": null,
      "trigger": "click",
      "components": [
        {"type": "cohezion-void-sphere", "scale": 0.05, "dustCount": 100},
        {"type": "cohezion-narration", "text": "In the beginning..."}
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "explosion",
      "duration": 2000,
      "components": [
        {"type": "cohezion-explosion", "phase": "exploding", "particleCount": 500},
        {"type": "cohezion-sound-engine", "phase": "explosion"},
        {"type": "cohezion-narration", "text": "From the void, symmetry crystallizes..."}
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

This is **testable** — an agent can validate the JSON structure, verify transitions, and check that each scene references valid catalog components.

### 2.4 A2UI Renderer
Build a thin rendering layer that reads the experience script and instantiates the React/R3F components from the catalog. This bridges A2UI's declarative format to our existing Three.js infrastructure.

## Phase 3: AG-UI Event Streaming (1-2 sessions)

Replace the ad-hoc SSE/WebSocket mix with AG-UI typed events.

### 3.1 Define event types
Map our existing events to AG-UI format:
- `TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT` → narration text
- `TOOL_CALL_START` → cosmogony phase transition starting
- `TOOL_CALL_RESULT` → phase transition complete with new state
- `STATE_DELTA` → universe tick (coherence, temperature, CA state)
- `RUN_FINISHED` → cosmogony animation complete

### 3.2 AG-UI SSE endpoint
Replace `/api/universe/stream` with an AG-UI-compatible SSE endpoint that emits typed events. Use `ag_ui_adk` or implement the event format directly.

### 3.3 Frontend AG-UI consumer
Replace useUniverseStream.ts with an AG-UI client that understands typed events and routes them to the correct components.

## Phase 4: Update CLAUDE.md Protocol Stack

Update the protocol table in CLAUDE.md to show full coverage:

| Protocol | Status | Implementation |
|----------|--------|---------------|
| MCP | Strong | 41+ tools |
| A2A | Strong | 7 agents + agent.json |
| A2UI | Strong | Genesis component catalog + declarative experience scripts |
| AG-UI | Strong | Typed SSE events for all Genesis interactions |

## Verification

### Phase 1 (immediate)
- Playwright: narration text visible after click
- Playwright: zero console errors on all tabs
- Manual: sound is pleasant (ambient, not harsh)

### Phase 2 (A2UI)
- Component catalog JSON validates against A2UI schema
- Experience script references only catalog components
- Renderer produces identical visual output to current hardcoded components

### Phase 3 (AG-UI)
- SSE endpoint emits AG-UI typed events
- Frontend renders correctly from typed events
- Events are structured enough for agent testing/verification

## Priority

1. **Phase 1** — fix broken features NOW (sound, narration, errors)
2. **Phase 2** — A2UI component catalog (makes the Genesis experience testable + protocol-compliant)
3. **Phase 3** — AG-UI streaming (completes the protocol stack)

# Plan: Genesis TDD Fixes + A2UI/AG-UI Protocol Stack

## Context

The Genesis webapp (Next.js + React Three Fiber) is live on Tailscale Funnel but has 5 verified bugs. Strategically, Google's A2UI and AG-UI protocols present an opportunity: Cohezion already implements MCP + A2A, adding A2UI + AG-UI makes it one of the first full agent protocol stack implementations. The strategic work (declarative component catalog) also solves the immediate problem — making the Genesis experience agent-testable.

**Branch:** Must create worktree off `main` (currently on protected `challenge/nvidia-nemotron-reasoning`)
**Worktree:** `cz worktree create --json genesis-tdd-a2ui` → works in `.worktrees/spec-genesis-tdd-a2ui-*/`

---

## Phase 1: Fix 5 Genesis Bugs (TDD with Playwright MCP)

### 1.0 Setup worktree
- `cz worktree create --json genesis-tdd-a2ui`
- Ensure Next.js dev server starts: `cd src/web/anima_dashboard && npm run dev`
- Start FastAPI: `uv run uvicorn cohezion.api:app --port 8080`

### 1.1 Playwright smoke test baseline
Use Playwright MCP browser tools (not test files) to establish current state:
- Navigate to `http://localhost:3000/genesis`
- `browser_snapshot` to capture initial DOM state
- `browser_console_messages` to log JS errors (especially 404s)
- Click the void sphere, observe behavior

### 1.2 Fix: "CLICK TO BEGIN" overlaps VoidQuote
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
**Root cause:** VoidSphere's "click to begin" `<Html>` at `position={[0, -1.2, 0]}` and VoidQuote at `position={[0, -1.5, 0]}` project to nearly the same screen Y.
**Fix:** Move VoidQuote position to `[0, 1.5, 0]` (above the sphere) or merge both into a single `<Html>` overlay below the sphere with proper stacking. Preferred: move quote above sphere (`y=1.2`), keep "click to begin" below (`y=-1.2`).
**Test:** Playwright snapshot shows both texts visible and non-overlapping.

### 1.3 Fix: Cosmogony sidebar visible during void
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
**Root cause:** The `uiOpacity` gating (line 729-734) correctly returns 0 when `!hasInteracted`, but the equation panel and transition markers may still flash briefly or the container div itself may be visible. Need to verify live.
**Fix:** Ensure all sidebar elements have `display: none` (not just `opacity: 0`) when `uiOpacity === 0`, or wrap in conditional rendering `{uiOpacity > 0 && ...}` (which it already does — if still visible, it's a different element).
**Test:** Playwright snapshot before click shows no sidebar elements.

### 1.4 Fix: API 404 spam
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useCosmogony.ts` (line 115)
**Root cause:** `fetch(\`${API_BASE}/api/genesis/cosmogony/set-temperature\`, ...)` — this endpoint doesn't exist. Local Landau math already handles temperature computation.
**Fix:** Remove the fetch call entirely. The `computeLocalCosmogony()` in GenesisScene.tsx handles everything offline.
**Test:** `browser_console_messages` shows zero 404 errors after page load + interaction.

### 1.5 Fix: Sound too loud/harsh
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useSonification.ts`
**Root cause:** Master gain at 0.5, sawtooth waveform (line 180) is harsh, attacks too sharp.
**Fix:**
- Reduce master gain: `new Tone.Gain(0.15)` (was 0.5)
- Change sawtooth to triangle: `oscillator: { type: "triangle" }` (line 180)
- Soften all attacks: increase `attack` values by 2-3x across all envelopes
- Reduce noise volume: `-40` (was `-30`, line 154)
- Reduce fabric gain: `0.03` (was `0.06`, line 339), `0.02` (was `0.04`, line 353)
**Test:** Toggle sound on, no JS errors, no audio distortion at default volume.

### 1.6 Fix: Narration may not display
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useNarration.ts` + `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/app/genesis/page.tsx`
**Root cause:** The overlay renders when `narration.currentText` is truthy (page.tsx line 229). If the API call fails or `narrateStage()` doesn't set `currentText`, overlay never appears.
**Fix:**
- Add console.log in `narrateStage` to trace state changes
- If API is unreachable, set `currentText` from the hardcoded narration map (already in useNarration.ts or from cosmogony narration strings)
- Ensure `currentText` is set immediately when `narrateStage` is called, not only after API response
**Test:** Playwright snapshot after clicking void shows narration text overlay.

---

## Phase 2: A2UI Component Catalog

### 2.1 Research A2UI spec
- Clone `https://github.com/google/A2UI.git` to `~/dev/A2UI`
- Study the 18 component primitives, JSON schema, and rendering pipeline
- Document which primitives map to Genesis components

### 2.2 Define component catalog
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/catalog.json`
Map existing React/R3F components to A2UI declarative format:
- `cohezion-void-sphere` → VoidSphere component
- `cohezion-explosion` → ExplosionParticles component
- `cohezion-bloch-sphere` → interactive 3D scene
- `cohezion-narration` → overlay text with TTS
- `cohezion-sound-engine` → Tone.js audio layer

### 2.3 Define experience script
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/experiences/genesis-cosmogony.json`
Declarative timeline replacing imperative phase logic in GenesisScene.tsx:
- Scenes: void → explosion → fabric-differentiation → settling → HIHO
- Each scene references catalog components with props
- Transitions defined as triggers (click, timer, temperature threshold)

### 2.4 Build A2UI renderer
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/A2UIRenderer.tsx`
Thin rendering layer that:
- Reads experience script JSON
- Instantiates React/R3F components from catalog
- Manages scene transitions
- Exposes component tree as inspectable JSON for agent testing

### 2.5 Refactor GenesisScene to use renderer
**Modified:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
Replace hardcoded phase logic with A2UI renderer consuming the experience script. Visual output should be identical — this is a refactor, not a redesign.

**Verification:** Side-by-side comparison using Playwright screenshots before/after refactor.

---

## Phase 3: AG-UI Event Streaming

### 3.1 Define AG-UI event types
**New file:** `src/cohezion/api/agui_events.py`
Map existing SSE events to AG-UI typed format:
- `TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT` → narration text
- `TOOL_CALL_START/RESULT` → phase transitions
- `STATE_DELTA` → universe ticks (coherence, temperature, CA)
- `RUN_FINISHED` → animation complete

### 3.2 AG-UI SSE endpoint
**New file:** `src/cohezion/api/routes/agui.py`
Replace `/api/universe/stream` with AG-UI-compatible SSE endpoint. Mount in FastAPI app.

### 3.3 Frontend AG-UI consumer
**Modified:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useUniverseStream.ts`
Replace custom SSE parsing with AG-UI typed event consumer. Route events to correct components.

**Verification:** SSE endpoint returns valid AG-UI events; frontend renders correctly from typed events.

---

## Phase 4: Documentation + Protocol Table

### 4.1 Update CLAUDE.md protocol table
Update the "What Cohezion Already Has" section with:
- A2UI: Strong — Genesis component catalog + declarative experience scripts
- AG-UI: Strong — Typed SSE events for all Genesis interactions

### 4.2 Update A2A agent card
Ensure `/.well-known/agent.json` reflects A2UI component catalog availability.

---

## Files Modified Summary

| File | Phase | Change |
|------|-------|--------|
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx` | 1, 2.5 | Fix overlaps, sidebar; refactor to A2UI renderer |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useCosmogony.ts` | 1 | Remove 404 API call |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useSonification.ts` | 1 | Reduce volumes, soften timbres |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useNarration.ts` | 1 | Fix currentText fallback |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/app/genesis/page.tsx` | 1 | Debug narration overlay |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/catalog.json` | 2 | NEW: A2UI component catalog |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/experiences/genesis-cosmogony.json` | 2 | NEW: Declarative experience script |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/A2UIRenderer.tsx` | 2 | NEW: A2UI→React/R3F renderer |
| `src/cohezion/api/agui_events.py` | 3 | NEW: AG-UI event type definitions |
| `src/cohezion/api/routes/agui.py` | 3 | NEW: AG-UI SSE endpoint |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useUniverseStream.ts` | 3 | Refactor to AG-UI consumer |
| `CLAUDE.md` | 4 | Update protocol table |

## Verification (End-to-End)

### Phase 1
1. Start Next.js dev server + FastAPI
2. Playwright MCP: navigate to `/genesis`, take snapshot
3. Verify: "click to begin" and quote don't overlap, no sidebar visible
4. Click void sphere → verify animation starts, narration text appears
5. `browser_console_messages` → zero 404 errors
6. Toggle sound → no JS errors, audio is ambient not harsh

### Phase 2
1. Validate `catalog.json` against A2UI schema (once spec is studied)
2. Experience script references only catalog components
3. Playwright screenshot comparison: before/after refactor produces identical visuals

### Phase 3
1. `curl http://localhost:8080/api/agui/stream` → valid AG-UI SSE events
2. Frontend reconnects to new endpoint, renders correctly
3. Events are structured JSON with AG-UI type field

### Phase 4
1. CLAUDE.md protocol table shows 4/6 protocols as "Strong"

# Plan: Genesis TDD Fixes + A2UI/AG-UI Protocol Stack

## Context

The Genesis webapp (Next.js + React Three Fiber) is live on Tailscale Funnel but has 5 verified bugs. Strategically, Google's A2UI and AG-UI protocols present an opportunity: Cohezion already implements MCP + A2A, adding A2UI + AG-UI makes it one of the first full agent protocol stack implementations. The strategic work (declarative component catalog) also solves the immediate problem — making the Genesis experience agent-testable.

**Branch:** Must create worktree off `main` (currently on protected `challenge/nvidia-nemotron-reasoning`)
**Worktree:** `cz worktree create --json genesis-tdd-a2ui` → works in `.worktrees/spec-genesis-tdd-a2ui-*/`

---

## Phase 1: Fix 5 Genesis Bugs (TDD with Playwright MCP)

### 1.0 Setup worktree
- `cz worktree create --json genesis-tdd-a2ui`
- Ensure Next.js dev server starts: `cd src/web/anima_dashboard && npm run dev`
- Start FastAPI: `uv run uvicorn cohezion.api:app --port 8080`

### 1.1 Playwright smoke test baseline
Use Playwright MCP browser tools (not test files) to establish current state:
- Navigate to `http://localhost:3000/genesis`
- `browser_snapshot` to capture initial DOM state
- `browser_console_messages` to log JS errors (especially 404s)
- Click the void sphere, observe behavior

### 1.2 Fix: "CLICK TO BEGIN" overlaps VoidQuote
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
**Root cause:** VoidSphere's "click to begin" `<Html>` at `position={[0, -1.2, 0]}` and VoidQuote at `position={[0, -1.5, 0]}` project to nearly the same screen Y.
**Fix:** Move VoidQuote position to `[0, 1.5, 0]` (above the sphere) or merge both into a single `<Html>` overlay below the sphere with proper stacking. Preferred: move quote above sphere (`y=1.2`), keep "click to begin" below (`y=-1.2`).
**Test:** Playwright snapshot shows both texts visible and non-overlapping.

### 1.3 Fix: Cosmogony sidebar visible during void
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
**Root cause:** The `uiOpacity` gating (line 729-734) correctly returns 0 when `!hasInteracted`, but the equation panel and transition markers may still flash briefly or the container div itself may be visible. Need to verify live.
**Fix:** Ensure all sidebar elements have `display: none` (not just `opacity: 0`) when `uiOpacity === 0`, or wrap in conditional rendering `{uiOpacity > 0 && ...}` (which it already does — if still visible, it's a different element).
**Test:** Playwright snapshot before click shows no sidebar elements.

### 1.4 Fix: API 404 spam
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useCosmogony.ts` (line 115)
**Root cause:** `fetch(\`${API_BASE}/api/genesis/cosmogony/set-temperature\`, ...)` — this endpoint doesn't exist. Local Landau math already handles temperature computation.
**Fix:** Remove the fetch call entirely. The `computeLocalCosmogony()` in GenesisScene.tsx handles everything offline.
**Test:** `browser_console_messages` shows zero 404 errors after page load + interaction.

### 1.5 Fix: Sound too loud/harsh
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useSonification.ts`
**Root cause:** Master gain at 0.5, sawtooth waveform (line 180) is harsh, attacks too sharp.
**Fix:**
- Reduce master gain: `new Tone.Gain(0.15)` (was 0.5)
- Change sawtooth to triangle: `oscillator: { type: "triangle" }` (line 180)
- Soften all attacks: increase `attack` values by 2-3x across all envelopes
- Reduce noise volume: `-40` (was `-30`, line 154)
- Reduce fabric gain: `0.03` (was `0.06`, line 339), `0.02` (was `0.04`, line 353)
**Test:** Toggle sound on, no JS errors, no audio distortion at default volume.

### 1.6 Fix: Narration may not display
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useNarration.ts` + `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/app/genesis/page.tsx`
**Root cause:** The overlay renders when `narration.currentText` is truthy (page.tsx line 229). If the API call fails or `narrateStage()` doesn't set `currentText`, overlay never appears.
**Fix:**
- Add console.log in `narrateStage` to trace state changes
- If API is unreachable, set `currentText` from the hardcoded narration map (already in useNarration.ts or from cosmogony narration strings)
- Ensure `currentText` is set immediately when `narrateStage` is called, not only after API response
**Test:** Playwright snapshot after clicking void shows narration text overlay.

---

## Phase 2: A2UI Component Catalog

### 2.1 Research A2UI spec
- Clone `https://github.com/google/A2UI.git` to `~/dev/A2UI`
- Study the 18 component primitives, JSON schema, and rendering pipeline
- Document which primitives map to Genesis components

### 2.2 Define component catalog
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/catalog.json`
Map existing React/R3F components to A2UI declarative format:
- `cohezion-void-sphere` → VoidSphere component
- `cohezion-explosion` → ExplosionParticles component
- `cohezion-bloch-sphere` → interactive 3D scene
- `cohezion-narration` → overlay text with TTS
- `cohezion-sound-engine` → Tone.js audio layer

### 2.3 Define experience script
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/experiences/genesis-cosmogony.json`
Declarative timeline replacing imperative phase logic in GenesisScene.tsx:
- Scenes: void → explosion → fabric-differentiation → settling → HIHO
- Each scene references catalog components with props
- Transitions defined as triggers (click, timer, temperature threshold)

### 2.4 Build A2UI renderer
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/A2UIRenderer.tsx`
Thin rendering layer that:
- Reads experience script JSON
- Instantiates React/R3F components from catalog
- Manages scene transitions
- Exposes component tree as inspectable JSON for agent testing

### 2.5 Refactor GenesisScene to use renderer
**Modified:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
Replace hardcoded phase logic with A2UI renderer consuming the experience script. Visual output should be identical — this is a refactor, not a redesign.

**Verification:** Side-by-side comparison using Playwright screenshots before/after refactor.

---

## Phase 3: AG-UI Event Streaming

### 3.1 Define AG-UI event types
**New file:** `src/cohezion/api/agui_events.py`
Map existing SSE events to AG-UI typed format:
- `TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT` → narration text
- `TOOL_CALL_START/RESULT` → phase transitions
- `STATE_DELTA` → universe ticks (coherence, temperature, CA)
- `RUN_FINISHED` → animation complete

### 3.2 AG-UI SSE endpoint
**New file:** `src/cohezion/api/routes/agui.py`
Replace `/api/universe/stream` with AG-UI-compatible SSE endpoint. Mount in FastAPI app.

### 3.3 Frontend AG-UI consumer
**Modified:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useUniverseStream.ts`
Replace custom SSE parsing with AG-UI typed event consumer. Route events to correct components.

**Verification:** SSE endpoint returns valid AG-UI events; frontend renders correctly from typed events.

---

## Phase 4: Documentation + Protocol Table

### 4.1 Update CLAUDE.md protocol table
Update the "What Cohezion Already Has" section with:
- A2UI: Strong — Genesis component catalog + declarative experience scripts
- AG-UI: Strong — Typed SSE events for all Genesis interactions

Ensure `/.well-known/agent.json` reflects A2UI component catalog availability.

**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
**Root cause:** VoidSphere's "click to begin" `<Html>` at `position={[0, -1.2, 0]}` and VoidQuote at `position={[0, -1.5, 0]}` project to nearly the same screen Y.
**Fix:** Move VoidQuote position to `[0, 1.5, 0]` (above the sphere) or merge both into a single `<Html>` overlay below the sphere with proper stacking. Preferred: move quote above sphere (`y=1.2`), keep "click to begin" below (`y=-1.2`).
**Test:** Playwright snapshot shows both texts visible and non-overlapping.

### 1.3 Fix: Cosmogony sidebar visible during void
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
**Root cause:** The `uiOpacity` gating (line 729-734) correctly returns 0 when `!hasInteracted`, but the equation panel and transition markers may still flash briefly or the container div itself may be visible. Need to verify live.
**Fix:** Ensure all sidebar elements have `display: none` (not just `opacity: 0`) when `uiOpacity === 0`, or wrap in conditional rendering `{uiOpacity > 0 && ...}` (which it already does — if still visible, it's a different element).

### 1.4 Fix: API 404 spam
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useCosmogony.ts` (line 115)

**Fix:**
- Reduce master gain: `new Tone.Gain(0.15)` (was 0.5)
- Change sawtooth to triangle: `oscillator: { type: "triangle" }` (line 180)
- Soften all attacks: increase `attack` values by 2-3x across all envelopes
- Reduce noise volume: `-40` (was `-30`, line 154)
- Reduce fabric gain: `0.03` (was `0.06`, line 339), `0.02` (was `0.04`, line 353)
**Test:** Toggle sound on, no JS errors, no audio distortion at default volume.

**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useNarration.ts` + `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/app/genesis/page.tsx`
**Root cause:** The overlay renders when `narration.currentText` is truthy (page.tsx line 229). If the API call fails or `narrateStage()` doesn't set `currentText`, overlay never appears.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# PreToolUse: Edit|Write
# Blocks edits on protected branches unless in an active worktree.
# Uses PreToolUse JSON protocol: {"decision": "block"} to prevent edits.

# Read stdin (hook JSON payload) to check file path
HOOK_INPUT=$(cat)

# Extract file_path from hook input (Edit or Write tool)
FILE_PATH=$(echo "$HOOK_INPUT" | python3 -c "
import sys, json
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    print(data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', ''))
except Exception:
    print('')
" 2>/dev/null)

# If file is outside the git repo root, always allow
if [ -n "$FILE_PATH" ]; then
    REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$REPO_ROOT" ]; then
        # Resolve to absolute path for comparison
        ABS_FILE=$(python3 -c "import os; print(os.path.abspath('$FILE_PATH'))" 2>/dev/null)
        case "$ABS_FILE" in
            "$REPO_ROOT"/*) ;; # Inside repo, continue checks
            *) exit 0 ;;       # Outside repo, allow unconditionally
        esac
    fi
fi

PROTECTED_PATTERNS=("main" "develop" "challenge/*" "release/*")

branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "")
worktree_active=$(cz worktree status --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('active', False))" 2>/dev/null)

# If in an active worktree, always allow (worktree IS the isolation)
if [ "$worktree_active" = "True" ]; then
    exit 0
fi

# Check if branch matches any protected pattern
is_protected=false
for pattern in "${PROTECTED_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
    case "$branch" in
        $pattern) is_protected=true; break ;;
    esac
done

if [ "$is_protected" = true ]; then
    echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"BLOCKED: Editing on protected branch '"'$branch'"'. Create a worktree first: cz worktree create --json <slug>"}'
    exit 0
fi

exit 0

#!/bin/bash

# Ralph Loop Setup Script
# Creates state file for in-session Ralph loop

set -euo pipefail

# Parse arguments
PROMPT_PARTS=()
MAX_ITERATIONS=0
COMPLETION_PROMISE="null"

# Parse options and positional arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
  case $1 in
    -h|--help)
      cat << 'HELP_EOF'
Ralph Loop - Interactive self-referential development loop

USAGE:
  /ralph-loop [PROMPT...] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
  PROMPT...    Initial prompt to start the loop (can be multiple words without quotes)

OPTIONS:
  --max-iterations <n>           Maximum iterations before auto-stop (default: unlimited)
  --completion-promise '<text>'  Promise phrase (USE QUOTES for multi-word)
  -h, --help                     Show this help message

DESCRIPTION:
  Starts a Ralph Loop in your CURRENT session. The stop hook prevents
  exit and feeds your output back as input until completion or iteration limit.

  To signal completion, you must output: <promise>YOUR_PHRASE</promise>

  Use this for:
  - Interactive iteration where you want to see progress
  - Tasks requiring self-correction and refinement
  - Learning how Ralph works

EXAMPLES:
  /ralph-loop Build a todo API --completion-promise 'DONE' --max-iterations 20
  /ralph-loop --max-iterations 10 Fix the auth bug
  /ralph-loop Refactor cache layer  (runs forever)
  /ralph-loop --completion-promise 'TASK COMPLETE' Create a REST API

STOPPING:
  Only by reaching --max-iterations or detecting --completion-promise
  No manual stop - Ralph runs infinitely by default!

MONITORING:
  # View current iteration:
  grep '^iteration:' .claude/ralph-loop.local.md

  # View full state:
  head -10 .claude/ralph-loop.local.md
HELP_EOF
      exit 0
      ;;
    --max-iterations)
      if [[ -z "${2:-}" ]]; then
        echo "❌ Error: --max-iterations requires a number argument" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   Valid examples:" >&2
        echo "     --max-iterations 10" >&2
        echo "     --max-iterations 50" >&2
        echo "     --max-iterations 0  (unlimited)" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   You provided: --max-iterations (with no number)" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      if ! [[ "$2" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
        echo "❌ Error: --max-iterations must be a positive integer or 0, got: $2" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   Valid examples:" >&2
        echo "     --max-iterations 10" >&2
        echo "     --max-iterations 50" >&2
        echo "     --max-iterations 0  (unlimited)" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   Invalid: decimals (10.5), negative numbers (-5), text" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      MAX_ITERATIONS="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --completion-promise)
      if [[ -z "${2:-}" ]]; then
        echo "❌ Error: --completion-promise requires a text argument" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   Valid examples:" >&2
        echo "     --completion-promise 'DONE'" >&2
        echo "     --completion-promise 'TASK COMPLETE'" >&2
        echo "     --completion-promise 'All tests passing'" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   You provided: --completion-promise (with no text)" >&2
        echo "" >&2
        echo "   Note: Multi-word promises must be quoted!" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      COMPLETION_PROMISE="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    *)
      # Non-option argument - collect all as prompt parts
      PROMPT_PARTS+=("$1")
      shift
      ;;
  esac
done

# Join all prompt parts with spaces
PROMPT="${PROMPT_PARTS[*]:-}"

# Validate prompt is non-empty
if [[ -z "$PROMPT" ]]; then
  echo "❌ Error: No prompt provided" >&2
  echo "" >&2
  echo "   Ralph needs a task description to work on." >&2
  echo "" >&2
  echo "   Examples:" >&2
  echo "     /ralph-loop Build a REST API for todos" >&2
  echo "     /ralph-loop Fix the auth bug --max-iterations 20" >&2
  echo "     /ralph-loop --completion-promise 'DONE' Refactor code" >&2
  echo "" >&2
  echo "   For all options: /ralph-loop --help" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Create state file for stop hook (markdown with YAML frontmatter)
mkdir -p .claude

# Quote completion promise for YAML if it contains special chars or is not null
if [[ -n "$COMPLETION_PROMISE" ]] && [[ "$COMPLETION_PROMISE" != "null" ]]; then
  COMPLETION_PROMISE_YAML="\"$COMPLETION_PROMISE\""
else
  COMPLETION_PROMISE_YAML="null"
fi

cat > .claude/ralph-loop.local.md <<EOF
---
active: true
iteration: 1
session_id: ${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}
max_iterations: $MAX_ITERATIONS
completion_promise: $COMPLETION_PROMISE_YAML
started_at: "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
---

$PROMPT
EOF

# Output setup message
cat <<EOF
🔄 Ralph loop activated in this session!

Iteration: 1
Max iterations: $(if [[ $MAX_ITERATIONS -gt 0 ]]; then echo $MAX_ITERATIONS; else echo "unlimited"; fi)
Completion promise: $(if [[ "$COMPLETION_PROMISE" != "null" ]]; then echo "${COMPLETION_PROMISE//\"/} (ONLY output when TRUE - do not lie!)"; else echo "none (runs forever)"; fi)

The stop hook is now active. When you try to exit, the SAME PROMPT will be
fed back to you. You'll see your previous work in files, creating a
self-referential loop where you iteratively improve on the same task.

To monitor: head -10 .claude/ralph-loop.local.md

⚠️  WARNING: This loop cannot be stopped manually! It will run infinitely
    unless you set --max-iterations or --completion-promise.

🔄
EOF

# Output the initial prompt if provided
if [[ -n "$PROMPT" ]]; then
  echo ""
  echo "$PROMPT"
fi

# Display completion promise requirements if set
if [[ "$COMPLETION_PROMISE" != "null" ]]; then
  echo ""
  echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
  echo "CRITICAL - Ralph Loop Completion Promise"
  echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
  echo ""
  echo "To complete this loop, output this EXACT text:"
  echo "  <promise>$COMPLETION_PROMISE</promise>"
  echo ""
  echo "STRICT REQUIREMENTS (DO NOT VIOLATE):"
  echo "  ✓ Use <promise> XML tags EXACTLY as shown above"
  echo "  ✓ The statement MUST be completely and unequivocally TRUE"
  echo "  ✓ Do NOT output false statements to exit the loop"
  echo "  ✓ Do NOT lie even if you think you should exit"
  echo ""
  echo "IMPORTANT - Do not circumvent the loop:"
  echo "  Even if you believe you're stuck, the task is impossible,"
  echo "  or you've been running too long - you MUST NOT output a"
  echo "  false promise statement. The loop is designed to continue"
  echo "  until the promise is GENUINELY TRUE. Trust the process."
  echo ""
  echo "  If the loop should stop, the promise statement will become"
  echo "  true naturally. Do not force it by lying."
  echo "═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════"
fi

Here's a comprehensive overview of **Google's A2UI (Agent-to-User Interface) Protocol**:

## What is A2UI?

A2UI is a streaming protocol for Agent-Driven User Interfaces. It is an open-source project, complete with a format optimized for representing updatable agent-generated UIs and an initial set of renderers, that allows agents to generate or populate rich user interfaces.

Google made the A2UI project public on December 15, 2025, and it was designed to address the specific challenges of interoperable, cross-platform, generative or template-based UI responses from agents.

## How It Works

An agent does not output HTML or JavaScript. It outputs an A2UI response, which is a JSON payload that describes a set of components, their properties and a data model. The client application reads this description and maps each component to its own native widgets, for example Angular components, Flutter widgets, web components, React components or SwiftUI views.

The pipeline has four stages:

1. **Generation:** An Agent (using Gemini or another LLM) generates or uses a pre-generated A2UI Response, a JSON payload describing the composition of UI components and their properties.
2. **Transport:** This message is sent to the client application (via A2A, AG UI, etc.).
3. **Resolution:** The Client's A2UI Renderer parses the JSON.
4. **Rendering:** The Renderer maps the abstract components (e.g., type: 'text-field') to the concrete implementation in the client's codebase.

## Key Design Principles

- **Security First:** Running arbitrary code generated by an LLM may present a security risk. A2UI is a declarative data format, not executable code. Your client application maintains a "catalog" of trusted, pre-approved UI components (e.g., Card, Button, TextField), and the agent can only request to render components from that catalog.

- **LLM-Friendly:** The UI is represented as a flat list of components with ID references which is easy for LLMs to generate incrementally, allowing for progressive rendering and a responsive user experience. An agent can efficiently make incremental changes to the UI based on new user requests as the conversation progresses.

- **Framework-Agnostic:** A2UI separates the UI structure from the UI implementation. The agent sends a description of the component tree and its associated data model. Your client application is responsible for mapping these abstract descriptions to its native widgets. The same A2UI JSON payload from an agent can be rendered on multiple different clients built on top of different frameworks.

## Current Status

A2UI is currently in v0.8 (Public Preview). The specification and implementations are functional but are still evolving. They are opening the project to foster collaboration, gather feedback, and solicit contributions. Expect changes.

## Ecosystem & Licensing

A2UI is an Apache 2 licensed project. A2UI is not intended to replace existing agent frameworks but to serve as a specialized protocol for interoperable, generative UI responses. It fits into a broader ecosystem of agent communication standards. The Agent-User Interaction Protocol (AG-UI), developed by CopilotKit, is often discussed alongside A2UI. They are complementary layers, not competing technologies.

## Competitive Landscape

For UI at least, there are now two fairly clear approaches: Build a mini web app (favored by OpenAI and Anthropic, and now supported by MCP Apps) or take a "native-first" approach with Google's A2UI.

## Key Resources

- **Official site:** [a2ui.org](https://a2ui.org/)
- **GitHub repo:** [github.com/google/A2UI](https://github.com/google/A2UI/)
- **Google Developers Blog:** [Introducing A2UI](https://developers.googleblog.com/introducing-a2ui-an-open-project-for-agent-driven-interfaces/)

Here's a comprehensive overview of the **AG-UI (Agent-User Interaction) Protocol** and its relationship with Google's **A2UI** specification and **CopilotKit**:

---

## AG-UI Protocol Overview

AG-UI (Agent–User Interaction) is a general-purpose, bi-directional connection between a user-facing application and any agentic backend. It is the connective layer that transforms agents from background processes into true collaborators — transparent, reliable, and always aligned with the user.

AG-UI was born from CopilotKit's initial partnership with LangGraph and CrewAI — and brings the incredibly popular agent-user-interactivity infrastructure to the wider agentic ecosystem.

### Key Capabilities

- **Shared State:** Bi-directional synchronization of agent and application state — either read/write or read-only.
- AG‑UI is an open, event-based protocol that standardizes the live stream between agent and app: messages, tool calls, state updates, and UI surface events.
- You can build integrations for new agent frameworks, custom in-house solutions, or use AG-UI without any agent framework. You can also build new clients for AG-UI-compatible agents (web, mobile, Slack, messaging, etc.).

---

## AG-UI vs. A2UI (Google) — Complementary, Not Competing

While MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) handle context and agent coordination, AG-UI defines the layer of interaction between the user, the application, and the agent.

A2UI is a generative UI specification (from Google) — which agents can use to deliver UI widgets, where AG-UI provides the complete bi-directional runtime connection between any agentic backend and a user-facing application.

A2UI is Apache 2.0 licensed, created by Google with contributions from CopilotKit and the open source community, and is in active development on GitHub. The problem A2UI solves is: how can AI agents safely send rich UIs across trust boundaries? Instead of text-only responses or risky code execution, A2UI lets agents send declarative component descriptions that clients render using their own native widgets.

In short: Agent Spec defines what runs, AG‑UI carries the interaction, and A2UI defines what the user touches.

---

## Google ADK + AG-UI Integration

Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) now works with AG-UI, an open protocol for building rich, interactive AI user experiences. By combining a powerful backend (ADK) with a flexible frontend protocol (AG-UI), you can build truly interactive AI applications. ADK runs the agent's "brain" and tool orchestration, while AG-UI provides a communication channel to UI components for a seamless user experience.

---

## CopilotKit Implementation

CopilotKit provides first-class support for the AG-UI protocol across its entire stack, using it as the foundation for agent-to-UI communication.

The CopilotKit runtime (`@copilotkit/runtime`) consumes AG-UI messages from agents and translates them into GraphQL events that stream to the frontend. CopilotKit's React SDK provides hooks like `useAgent` and `useCoAgent` for consuming AG-UI streams.

Framework flexibility is supported with AG-UI clients available for React, Angular, Vue, etc. Standard inspector tools exist for AG-UI message streams, and agents and UIs from different vendors can work together through the protocol's interoperability.

---

## Industry Collaboration (Oracle, Google, CopilotKit)

Oracle, CopilotKit, and Google are aligning three open specifications so agentic apps can be assembled end-to-end with portable parts: Open Agent Specification (from Oracle), AG‑UI (from CopilotKit), and A2UI (from Google). The goal is to swap implementations at any layer while keeping the experience stable.

---

### Key Resources
- **AG-UI Docs:** [docs.ag-ui.com](https://docs.ag-ui.com/)
- **GitHub:** [github.com/ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui](https://github.com/ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui)
- **A2UI Spec:** [a2ui.org](https://a2ui.org/)
- **CopilotKit AG-UI Docs:** [docs.copilotkit.ai/learn/ag-ui-protocol](https://docs.copilotkit.ai/learn/ag-ui-protocol)

# A2UI Specification Summary

Based on the provided documentation, here's what I can extract about A2UI's structure:

## Core Definition
"A2UI (Agent to UI) is a declarative UI protocol for agent-driven interfaces. AI agents generate rich, interactive UIs that render natively across platforms (web, mobile, desktop) without executing arbitrary code."

## Message Structure

The protocol uses JSON messages with these key types:
- `surfaceUpdate` / `updateComponents` (v0.9)
- `dataModelUpdate`
- `beginRendering` / `createSurface` (v0.9)

## Component Format (v0.8)
Components use nested objects:
```json
{
  "id": "component-id",
  "component": {
    "ComponentType": {
      "property": "value"
    }
  }
}
```

## Component Format (v0.9 - Simplified)
```json
{
  "id": "component-id",
  "component": "Text",
  "text": "Content",
  "variant": "h1"
}
```

## Key Architectural Elements

**Surface**: "Canvas for components (dialog, sidebar, main view)"

**Catalog**: Referenced by ID (e.g., `"https://a2ui.org/specification/v0_9/basic_catalog.json"`), defines available component types

**Data Model**: State structure with path-based references like `{"path": "/booking/date"}`

**Actions**: Components trigger events with `"action": {"event": {"name": "event_name"}}`

## Important Limitation
The documentation provided is introductory only. For complete JSON schema, full catalog definitions, and comprehensive component type specifications, you'll need to review the [formal specification documents](../../specification/) linked in the navigation.

The documentation defines a surface as: *"Canvas for components (dialog, sidebar, main view)"* but doesn't enumerate specific surface type definitions.

## Data Model Format
Data is structured hierarchically using key-value mappings with paths. The example shows: `{ "key": "booking", "valueMap": [{ "key": "date", "valueString": "2025-12-16T19:00:00Z" }] }`

## Action Format
Actions reference event names passed to components. The structure shown: `"action": { "name": "confirm_booking" }` in v0.8, evolving to `"action": { "event": { "name": "confirm_booking" } }` in v0.9.

## Limitation
The page references a complete *"Component Gallery"* and *"Message Reference"* in separate documentation sections but doesn't list all available components. For comprehensive component details, you'd need to consult the [Component Gallery reference page](../../reference/components/).

"""
AG-UI SSE endpoint for the Cohezion Genesis Engine.

Streams typed AG-UI events for the cosmogony animation, enabling
agent-testable and protocol-compliant event streaming.

Mount in FastAPI: app.include_router(agui_router, prefix="/api/agui")
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import math
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator

from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.responses import StreamingResponse

from cohezion.api.agui_events import (
    CustomEvent,
    RunFinishedEvent,
    RunStartedEvent,
    StateSnapshotEvent,
    narration_event,
    phase_transition_event,
    universe_tick_event,
)

agui_router = APIRouter(tags=["ag-ui"])

# --- Cosmogony simulation (matches GenesisScene.tsx Landau math) ---

CRITICAL_TEMPS = [100.0, 10.0, 1.0, 0.1, 0.01]
SYMMETRIES = ["void", "SO(12)", "SO(3)^4", "U(1)^4", "Z_2^4", "HIHO"]
NARRATIONS = {
    "void": "In the beginning, there was nothing. Not even nothing.",
    "SO(12)": "From the first observation, symmetry crystallized. Twelve dimensions, all equivalent.",
    "SO(3)^4": "The fabrics separated. Space. Field. Control. Precipitation.",
    "U(1)^4": "Within each world, a preferred direction emerged.",
    "Z_2^4": "The discrete choice. Up or down. Brahmagupta's zero gave nothing a name.",
    "HIHO": "At the still point, the dance began. Half in, half out. The balance that creates.",
}


def compute_cosmogony(temperature: float) -> dict:
    """Compute Landau cosmogony state for a given temperature."""
    stage_idx = 0
    for i, tc in enumerate(CRITICAL_TEMPS):
        if temperature < tc:
            stage_idx = i + 1

    symmetry = SYMMETRIES[stage_idx]

    a, b = 1.0, 0.5
    critical_temp = CRITICAL_TEMPS[max(0, stage_idx - 1)] if stage_idx > 0 else 100.0
    order_param = (
        math.sqrt(a * (critical_temp - temperature) / (2 * b))
        if temperature < critical_temp
        else 0.0
    )
    landau_fe = (
        a * (temperature - critical_temp) * order_param**2 + b * order_param**4
        if order_param > 0
        else 0.0
    )

    closest_tc = min(CRITICAL_TEMPS, key=lambda tc: abs(tc - temperature))
    fisher_eig = 1 / (abs(temperature - closest_tc) + 0.01) if closest_tc > 0 else 0.0

    coherence = 1.0 - abs(order_param - 0.5) * 2 if order_param > 0 else 0.0

    return {
        "temperature": temperature,
        "symmetry": symmetry,
        "stage": stage_idx - 1,
        "orderParameter": order_param,
        "landauFreeEnergy": landau_fe,
        "fisherEigenvalue": fisher_eig,
        "coherence": coherence,
    }


async def cosmogony_stream() -> AsyncIterator[str]:
    """
    Stream the Genesis cosmogony as AG-UI typed events.

    Simulates the 10-second cooling animation from T=200 to T=0.01,
    emitting state deltas, phase transitions, and narration events.
    """
    # --- RUN_STARTED ---
    run = RunStartedEvent()
    yield run.to_sse()

    # --- Initial state snapshot ---
    initial = compute_cosmogony(200.0)
    yield StateSnapshotEvent(snapshot=initial).to_sse()

    # --- Void narration ---
    for event in narration_event(NARRATIONS["void"], "void"):
        yield event.to_sse()

    # --- Cooling animation (10 seconds, 100 ticks) ---
    t_start = 200.0
    t_end = 0.01
    num_ticks = 100
    tick_interval = 0.1  # 100ms per tick
    prev_symmetry = "void"

    for i in range(num_ticks):
        progress = (i + 1) / num_ticks
        # Exponential cooling: T = T_start * (T_end/T_start)^progress
        temperature = t_start * (t_end / t_start) ** progress

        state = compute_cosmogony(temperature)

        # Emit state delta
        yield universe_tick_event(
            temperature=state["temperature"],
            symmetry=state["symmetry"],
            coherence=state["coherence"],
            order_parameter=state["orderParameter"],
            landau_free_energy=state["landauFreeEnergy"],
        ).to_sse()

        # Check for phase transition
        if state["symmetry"] != prev_symmetry:
            # Emit phase transition tool call
            for event in phase_transition_event(prev_symmetry, state["symmetry"], temperature):
                yield event.to_sse()

            # Emit narration for new phase
            narration = NARRATIONS.get(state["symmetry"], "")
            if narration:
                for event in narration_event(narration, state["symmetry"]):
                    yield event.to_sse()

            prev_symmetry = state["symmetry"]

        await asyncio.sleep(tick_interval)

    # --- HIHO coherence event ---
    yield CustomEvent(
        name="hiho_equilibrium",
        value={"coherence": 0.5, "description": "Half-In, Half-Out equilibrium reached"},
    ).to_sse()

    # --- RUN_FINISHED ---
    yield RunFinishedEvent(
        thread_id=run.thread_id,
        run_id=run.run_id,
        result={"finalSymmetry": "HIHO", "finalTemperature": 0.01},
    ).to_sse()


@agui_router.get("/stream")
async def stream_cosmogony():
    """
    Stream the Genesis cosmogony as AG-UI typed SSE events.

    Returns a Server-Sent Events stream with typed AG-UI events:
    - RUN_STARTED / RUN_FINISHED (lifecycle)
    - STATE_SNAPSHOT / STATE_DELTA (universe state)
    - TEXT_MESSAGE_* (narration)
    - TOOL_CALL_* (phase transitions)
    - CUSTOM (HIHO equilibrium)
    """
    return StreamingResponse(
        cosmogony_stream(),
        media_type="text/event-stream",
        headers={
            "Cache-Control": "no-cache",
            "Connection": "keep-alive",
            "X-Accel-Buffering": "no",
            "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
        },
    )


@agui_router.get("/catalog")
async def get_a2ui_catalog():
    """Return the A2UI component catalog for agent inspection."""
    import json
    from pathlib import Path

    catalog_path = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent.parent / "web" / "anima_dashboard" / "src" / "a2ui" / "catalog.json"
    if catalog_path.exists():
        return json.loads(catalog_path.read_text())
    return {"error": "Catalog not found", "path": str(catalog_path)}

### 1.2 Fix: "CLICK TO BEGIN" overlaps VoidQuote
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
**Root cause:** VoidSphere's "click to begin" `<Html>` at `position={[0, -1.2, 0]}` and VoidQuote at `position={[0, -1.5, 0]}` project to nearly the same screen Y.
**Fix:** Move VoidQuote position to `[0, 1.5, 0]` (above the sphere) or merge both into a single `<Html>` overlay below the sphere with proper stacking. Preferred: move quote above sphere (`y=1.2`), keep "click to begin" below (`y=-1.2`).
**Test:** Playwright snapshot shows both texts visible and non-overlapping.

### 1.3 Fix: Cosmogony sidebar visible during void
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
**Root cause:** The `uiOpacity` gating (line 729-734) correctly returns 0 when `!hasInteracted`, but the equation panel and transition markers may still flash briefly or the container div itself may be visible. Need to verify live.
**Fix:** Ensure all sidebar elements have `display: none` (not just `opacity: 0`) when `uiOpacity === 0`, or wrap in conditional rendering `{uiOpacity > 0 && ...}` (which it already does — if still visible, it's a different element).
**Test:** Playwright snapshot before click shows no sidebar elements.

### 1.4 Fix: API 404 spam
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useCosmogony.ts` (line 115)
**Root cause:** `fetch(\`${API_BASE}/api/genesis/cosmogony/set-temperature\`, ...)` — this endpoint doesn't exist. Local Landau math already handles temperature computation.
**Fix:** Remove the fetch call entirely. The `computeLocalCosmogony()` in GenesisScene.tsx handles everything offline.
**Test:** `browser_console_messages` shows zero 404 errors after page load + interaction.

### 1.5 Fix: Sound too loud/harsh
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useSonification.ts`
**Root cause:** Master gain at 0.5, sawtooth waveform (line 180) is harsh, attacks too sharp.
**Fix:**
- Reduce master gain: `new Tone.Gain(0.15)` (was 0.5)
- Change sawtooth to triangle: `oscillator: { type: "triangle" }` (line 180)
- Soften all attacks: increase `attack` values by 2-3x across all envelopes
- Reduce noise volume: `-40` (was `-30`, line 154)
- Reduce fabric gain: `0.03` (was `0.06`, line 339), `0.02` (was `0.04`, line 353)
**Test:** Toggle sound on, no JS errors, no audio distortion at default volume.

### 1.6 Fix: Narration may not display
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useNarration.ts` + `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/app/genesis/page.tsx`
**Root cause:** The overlay renders when `narration.currentText` is truthy (page.tsx line 229). If the API call fails or `narrateStage()` doesn't set `currentText`, overlay never appears.
**Fix:**
- Add console.log in `narrateStage` to trace state changes
- If API is unreachable, set `currentText` from the hardcoded narration map (already in useNarration.ts or from cosmogony narration strings)
- Ensure `currentText` is set immediately when `narrateStage` is called, not only after API response
**Test:** Playwright snapshot after clicking void shows narration text overlay.

# Plan: Playwright E2E Tests for Genesis Fixes + A2UI

## Context

The Genesis bug fixes and A2UI/AG-UI protocol work are implemented on `feat/genesis-tdd-a2ui` (5 commits). However, the "TDD" was actually test-after verification using Playwright MCP interactively — no persistent test files were written. This plan adds proper Playwright e2e test specs that serve as regression tests for all 5 bug fixes and the A2UI demo page.

**Branch:** `feat/genesis-tdd-a2ui` (worktree at `.worktrees/genesis-tdd-a2ui`)
**Existing infrastructure:**
- `playwright.config.ts` — testDir: `./tests/e2e`, baseURL: `http://localhost:3000`
- `@playwright/test` ^1.58.2 installed
- 2 existing specs: `routing.spec.ts`, `portfolio.spec.ts`
- Dev server on port 3001 (worktree), production on port 3000 (systemd)

---

## Task: Write Playwright E2E Test Specs

### 1.0 Setup worktree
- `git stash` if needed, then create worktree off main:
  ```bash
  cd /home/mike-anderson/dev/cohezion
  git worktree add .worktrees/genesis-tdd-a2ui main -b feat/genesis-tdd-a2ui
  cd .worktrees/genesis-tdd-a2ui
  ```
- Services already running via systemd: `cohezion-genesis.service` (port 3000), `cohezion-api.service` (port 8080)
- Verify with Playwright: `browser_navigate` to `http://localhost:3000/genesis`

### 1.1 Playwright smoke test baseline
Use Playwright MCP browser tools (not test files) to establish current state:
- Navigate to `http://localhost:3000/genesis`
- `browser_snapshot` to capture initial DOM state
- `browser_console_messages` to log JS errors (especially 404s)
- Click the void sphere, observe behavior

### 1.2 Fix: "CLICK TO BEGIN" overlaps VoidQuote
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
**Root cause:** VoidSphere's "click to begin" `<Html>` at `position={[0, -1.2, 0]}` and VoidQuote at `position={[0, -1.5, 0]}` project to nearly the same screen Y.
**Fix:** Move VoidQuote position to `[0, 1.5, 0]` (above the sphere) or merge both into a single `<Html>` overlay below the sphere with proper stacking. Preferred: move quote above sphere (`y=1.2`), keep "click to begin" below (`y=-1.2`).
**Test:** Playwright snapshot shows both texts visible and non-overlapping.

### 1.3 Fix: Cosmogony sidebar visible during void
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
**Root cause:** The `uiOpacity` gating (line 729-734) correctly returns 0 when `!hasInteracted`, but the equation panel and transition markers may still flash briefly or the container div itself may be visible. Need to verify live.
**Fix:** Ensure all sidebar elements have `display: none` (not just `opacity: 0`) when `uiOpacity === 0`, or wrap in conditional rendering `{uiOpacity > 0 && ...}` (which it already does — if still visible, it's a different element).
**Test:** Playwright snapshot before click shows no sidebar elements.

### 1.4 Fix: API 404 spam
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useCosmogony.ts` (line 115)
**Root cause:** `fetch(\`${API_BASE}/api/genesis/cosmogony/set-temperature\`, ...)` — this endpoint doesn't exist. Local Landau math already handles temperature computation.
**Fix:** Remove the fetch call entirely. The `computeLocalCosmogony()` in GenesisScene.tsx handles everything offline.
**Test:** `browser_console_messages` shows zero 404 errors after page load + interaction.

### 1.5 Fix: Sound too loud/harsh
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useSonification.ts`
**Root cause:** Master gain at 0.5, sawtooth waveform (line 180) is harsh, attacks too sharp.
**Fix:**
- Reduce master gain: `new Tone.Gain(0.15)` (was 0.5)
- Change sawtooth to triangle: `oscillator: { type: "triangle" }` (line 180)
- Soften all attacks: increase `attack` values by 2-3x across all envelopes
- Reduce noise volume: `-40` (was `-30`, line 154)
- Reduce fabric gain: `0.03` (was `0.06`, line 339), `0.02` (was `0.04`, line 353)
**Test:** Toggle sound on, no JS errors, no audio distortion at default volume.

### 1.6 Fix: Narration may not display
**File:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useNarration.ts` + `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/app/genesis/page.tsx`
**Root cause:** The overlay renders when `narration.currentText` is truthy (page.tsx line 229). If the API call fails or `narrateStage()` doesn't set `currentText`, overlay never appears.
**Fix:**
- Add console.log in `narrateStage` to trace state changes
- If API is unreachable, set `currentText` from the hardcoded narration map (already in useNarration.ts or from cosmogony narration strings)
- Ensure `currentText` is set immediately when `narrateStage` is called, not only after API response
**Test:** Playwright snapshot after clicking void shows narration text overlay.

---

## Phase 2: A2UI Component Catalog

### 2.1 Research A2UI spec
- Clone `https://github.com/google/A2UI.git` to `~/dev/A2UI`
- Study the 18 component primitives, JSON schema, and rendering pipeline
- Document which primitives map to Genesis components

### 2.2 Define component catalog
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/catalog.json`
Map existing React/R3F components to A2UI declarative format:
- `cohezion-void-sphere` → VoidSphere component
- `cohezion-explosion` → ExplosionParticles component
- `cohezion-bloch-sphere` → interactive 3D scene
- `cohezion-narration` → overlay text with TTS
- `cohezion-sound-engine` → Tone.js audio layer

### 2.3 Define experience script
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/experiences/genesis-cosmogony.json`
Declarative timeline replacing imperative phase logic in GenesisScene.tsx:
- Scenes: void → explosion → fabric-differentiation → settling → HIHO
- Each scene references catalog components with props
- Transitions defined as triggers (click, timer, temperature threshold)

### 2.4 Build A2UI renderer
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/A2UIRenderer.tsx`
Thin rendering layer that:
- Reads experience script JSON
- Instantiates React/R3F components from catalog
- Manages scene transitions
- Exposes component tree as inspectable JSON for agent testing

### 2.5 Refactor GenesisScene to use renderer
**Modified:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx`
Replace hardcoded phase logic with A2UI renderer consuming the experience script. Visual output should be identical — this is a refactor, not a redesign.

**Verification:** Side-by-side comparison using Playwright screenshots before/after refactor.

---

## Phase 3: AG-UI Event Streaming

### 3.1 Define AG-UI event types
**New file:** `src/cohezion/api/agui_events.py`
Map existing SSE events to AG-UI typed format:
- `TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT` → narration text
- `TOOL_CALL_START/RESULT` → phase transitions
- `STATE_DELTA` → universe ticks (coherence, temperature, CA)
- `RUN_FINISHED` → animation complete

### 3.2 AG-UI SSE endpoint
**New file:** `src/cohezion/api/routes/agui.py`
Replace `/api/universe/stream` with AG-UI-compatible SSE endpoint. Mount in FastAPI app.

### 3.3 Frontend AG-UI consumer
**Modified:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useUniverseStream.ts`
Replace custom SSE parsing with AG-UI typed event consumer. Route events to correct components.

**Verification:** SSE endpoint returns valid AG-UI events; frontend renders correctly from typed events.

---

## Phase 4: Documentation + Protocol Table

### 4.1 Update CLAUDE.md protocol table
Update the "What Cohezion Already Has" section with:
- A2UI: Strong — Genesis component catalog + declarative experience scripts
- AG-UI: Strong — Typed SSE events for all Genesis interactions

### 4.2 Update A2A agent card
Ensure `/.well-known/agent.json` reflects A2UI component catalog availability.

---

## Files Modified Summary

| File | Phase | Change |
|------|-------|--------|
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/components/genesis/GenesisScene.tsx` | 1, 2.5 | Fix overlaps, sidebar; refactor to A2UI renderer |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useCosmogony.ts` | 1 | Remove 404 API call |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useSonification.ts` | 1 | Reduce volumes, soften timbres |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useNarration.ts` | 1 | Fix currentText fallback |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/app/genesis/page.tsx` | 1 | Debug narration overlay |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/catalog.json` | 2 | NEW: A2UI component catalog |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/experiences/genesis-cosmogony.json` | 2 | NEW: Declarative experience script |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/A2UIRenderer.tsx` | 2 | NEW: A2UI→React/R3F renderer |
| `src/cohezion/api/agui_events.py` | 3 | NEW: AG-UI event type definitions |
| `src/cohezion/api/routes/agui.py` | 3 | NEW: AG-UI SSE endpoint |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/useUniverseStream.ts` | 3 | Refactor to AG-UI consumer |
| `CLAUDE.md` | 4 | Update protocol table |

## Verification (End-to-End)

### Phase 1
1. Start Next.js dev server + FastAPI
2. Playwright MCP: navigate to `/genesis`, take snapshot
3. Verify: "click to begin" and quote don't overlap, no sidebar visible
4. Click void sphere → verify animation starts, narration text appears
5. `browser_console_messages` → zero 404 errors
6. Toggle sound → no JS errors, audio is ambient not harsh

### Phase 2
1. Validate `catalog.json` against A2UI schema (once spec is studied)
2. Experience script references only catalog components
3. Playwright screenshot comparison: before/after refactor produces identical visuals

### Phase 3
1. `curl http://localhost:8080/api/agui/stream` → valid AG-UI SSE events
2. Frontend reconnects to new endpoint, renders correctly
3. Events are structured JSON with AG-UI type field

### Phase 4
1. CLAUDE.md protocol table shows 4/6 protocols as "Strong"

# Pretext: Text Measurement Library

## What Is It?

Pretext is a "Pure JavaScript/TypeScript library for multiline text measurement & layout" that avoids expensive DOM operations. Rather than using `getBoundingClientRect()` or similar methods that trigger layout reflow, it implements its own text measurement using the browser's font engine as the source of truth.

## Core Functionality

The library solves two primary use cases:

1. **Height Measurement**: Calculate paragraph height without DOM interaction using `prepare()` and `layout()` functions
2. **Manual Layout**: Full control over line-by-line rendering for canvas, SVG, or custom implementations

## Key API Functions

- `prepare(text, font, options)` - One-time analysis pass that caches measurements
- `layout(prepared, maxWidth, lineHeight)` - Returns height and line count via pure arithmetic
- `prepareWithSegments()` - Richer structure for advanced layout control
- `layoutWithLines()` - Returns actual line text and metadata
- `walkLineRanges()` - Iterates lines without building strings (useful for width calculation)
- `layoutNextLine()` - Processes lines with varying widths

## Technical Details

**Language**: TypeScript (89.8%) with HTML (10.2%)

**Performance**: Approximately 19ms for prepare() on 500 texts; 0.09ms for layout()

**Language Support**: Handles multiple languages, emojis, and bidirectional text

## Integration Pattern

Install via `npm install @chenglou/pretext`, then:
1. Call `prepare()` once per text/font combination
2. Call `layout()` on resize or width changes
3. Use advanced APIs only when custom rendering is needed

The separation of expensive preparation from cheap layout computation is essential for performance.

## Pretext by Chenglou

Pretext is a pure JavaScript/TypeScript library for multiline text measurement and layout that avoids DOM reflow by implementing its own text measurement logic using the browser's font engine via Canvas.

### Key Features

- Pretext side-steps the need for DOM measurements (e.g. `getBoundingClientRect`, `offsetHeight`), which trigger layout reflow, one of the most expensive operations in the browser.
- It implements its own text measurement logic, using the browsers' own font engine as ground truth (very AI-friendly iteration method).

### API Overview

- `prepare()` does the one-time work: normalize whitespace, segment the text, apply glue rules, measure the segments with canvas, and return an opaque handle.
- `clearCache()` clears Pretext's shared internal caches used by `prepare()` and `prepareWithSegments()`, useful if your app cycles through many different fonts or text variants.
- `setLocale()` is optional (uses current locale by default) and sets locale for future `prepare()` and `prepareWithSegments()` calls.
- If you pass `{ whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap' }`, ordinary spaces, `\t` tabs, and `\n` hard breaks are preserved instead of collapsed. Tabs follow the default browser-style tab-size: 8. The other wrapping defaults stay the same: `word-break: normal`, `overflow-wrap: break-word`, and `line-break: auto`.

### Predecessor Project

The older `chenglou/text-layout` project is now archived. The ideas there evolved into Pretext, a production-ready library for DOM-free text measurement with full i18n support.

### Related Links

- **GitHub repo**: [github.com/chenglou/pretext](https://github.com/chenglou/pretext)

# Glance: AI-Powered Browser Automation

## What is Glance?

Glance is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that enables Claude Code to control a real browser. Rather than working from descriptions, Claude can "actually **see** it, **interact** with it, and **test** it."

## Core Functionality

The tool automates web interactions by letting Claude:
- Navigate to URLs and take screenshots
- Click elements, fill forms, and type text
- Monitor console messages and network activity
- Run multi-step test scenarios with assertions
- Record browser sessions and perform visual regression testing

## Technical Implementation

**Language:** TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js)

**Architecture:** Built on Playwright for browser automation, communicating with Claude via MCP's stdio transport. The system captures screenshots as base64 images and DOM snapshots as accessibility trees.

## Key APIs & Tools

Glance exposes 30 MCP tools organized into three categories:

1. **Browser Control (19 tools):** navigation, clicking, typing, scrolling, screenshot capture
2. **Test Automation (7 tools):** scenario running, assertions, form filling, event watching
3. **Session & Visual (4 tools):** recording playback and screenshot comparison

Assertions include element existence checks, text matching, URL verification, and console error detection.

## Integration Pattern

Add to your `.mcp.json` configuration:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "glance": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["glance-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Then simply ask Claude to test your application. It handles browser management automatically.

Observer Patch Holography (OPH) is an active research program attempting to construct a fundamental physics theory from a simple principle: overlapping local observer descriptions on a holographic screen must agree where they overlap.

## Core Concepts

The framework rests on five axioms centered around observer consistency:

- **Screen net**: Observable algebras exist on a closed 2D surface (S²)
- **Overlap consistency**: Where patches share regions, descriptions must agree
- **Local MaxEnt and Refinement Stability**: A finite local maximum-entropy family persists under refinement
- **Recoverable Generalized Entropy**: Information preservation with controlled collar dynamics
- **Minimal Admissible Realization**: Nature realizes the lexicographically minimal sector

The organization name suggests philosophical pragmatism—theories float or sink based on consistency and empirical grounding, not dogma.

## Context

Three external projects to integrate into the Genesis webapp and Cohezion physics stack:

1. **[pretext](https://github.com/chenglou/pretext)** — Pure JS text measurement library. `prepare()` + `layout()` avoids DOM reflow. Useful for precise cinematic narration text positioning in Genesis.
2. **[glance](https://github.com/DebugBase/glance)** — MCP server for browser automation with 30 tools, built-in test scenarios, and visual regression. Replaces/augments Playwright MCP for e2e testing.
3. **[observer-patch-holography](https://github.com/FloatingPragma/observer-patch-holography)** — Fundamental physics framework: spacetime emerges from overlapping observer patches on a holographic screen. Recovers SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1)/Z₆ gauge quotient from observer consistency. Deeply aligned with Cohezion's cosmogony (symmetry breaking) and SPIN coherence (phase alignment).

**Branch:** `feat/genesis-tdd-a2ui` (worktree at `.worktrees/genesis-tdd-a2ui`)

---

## Task 1: Integrate Pretext (narration text layout)

**Install:** `npm install @chenglou/pretext` in `src/web/anima_dashboard/`

**Integration point:** Replace DOM-dependent text layout in the Genesis narration overlay with Pretext's Canvas-based measurement.

### 1.1 Create `usePretext.ts` hook
**New file:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/usePretext.ts`
- Import `prepare`, `layout` from `@chenglou/pretext`
- `usePretextLayout(text, font, maxWidth)` → returns `{ height, lineCount }` without DOM reflow
- Used by narration overlay for precise positioning over the 3D canvas

### 1.2 Integrate into narration overlay
**Modified:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/app/genesis/page.tsx`
- Use Pretext to measure narration text height before rendering
- Position overlay precisely based on measured text dimensions
- Enables predictable cinematic text layout regardless of font loading

---

## Task 2: Integrate Glance (browser testing MCP)

**Install:** Add to `.mcp.json` as an MCP server

### 2.1 Add Glance MCP config
**Modified:** `.mcp.json` (or project MCP config)
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "glance": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["glance-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

### 2.2 Fix existing Playwright e2e tests
**Modified:** `tests/e2e/a2ui-demo.spec.ts` — fix 3 failing tests (aria-label selectors, timeout on auto-transitions)

The genesis.spec.ts tests already all pass (5/5 PASSED from the last run).

---

**Clone:** `git clone https://github.com/FloatingPragma/observer-patch-holography ~/dev/observer-patch-holography`

### 3.1 Study OPH axioms and map to Cohezion
Read the 5 axioms (Screen net, Overlap consistency, Local MaxEnt, Recoverable Entropy, Minimal Realization) and map them to Cohezion's existing physics:
- **Overlap consistency** → SPIN coherence (phase alignment)
- **Screen net on S²** → Bloch sphere representation
- **Local MaxEnt** → HIHO equilibrium (50% coherence = maximum entropy at information boundary)
- **Gauge quotient SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1)/Z₆** → Cohezion's SO(12) → symmetry breaking chain

### 3.2 Create OPH bridge module
**New file:** `src/cohezion/physics/observer_patch.py`
- Implement the overlap consistency check as a physics validator
- Map OPH's patch algebra to Cohezion's SpinorState
- Add `verify_observer_consistency(patch_a, patch_b)` function
- Connect to the cosmogony chain as a theoretical grounding layer

### 3.3 Add OPH to Genesis visualization
**Modified:** `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/catalog.json`
- Add `cohezion-observer-patch` component to A2UI catalog
- Visualize overlapping observer patches on the Bloch sphere
- Show where patches agree (coherence) and disagree (decoherence)

### 3.4 Update CLAUDE.md and Genesis About panel
- Add OPH to the foundational references table
- Link the overlap consistency principle to SPIN coherence
- Update the cosmogonic chain explanation with holographic grounding

---

## Files Summary

| File | Task | Action |
|------|------|--------|
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/package.json` | 1 | Add `@chenglou/pretext` dep |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/hooks/usePretext.ts` | 1 | NEW: Pretext text measurement hook |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/app/genesis/page.tsx` | 1 | Use Pretext for narration layout |
| `.mcp.json` | 2 | Add Glance MCP server |
| `tests/e2e/a2ui-demo.spec.ts` | 2 | Fix 3 failing tests |
| `src/cohezion/physics/observer_patch.py` | 3 | NEW: OPH bridge module |
| `src/web/anima_dashboard/src/a2ui/catalog.json` | 3 | Add observer-patch component |
| `CLAUDE.md` | 3 | Add OPH references |

## Verification

1. `npm run build` succeeds with Pretext dependency

3. `npx glance-mcp` starts and lists tools

6. `observer_patch.py` unit tests pass with `uv run pytest`
7. A2UI catalog validates with new observer-patch component

Here's a comprehensive synthesis of the cutting-edge AI agent landscape in 2026, covering protocols, frameworks, WebGPU, and spatial computing:

---

## 🔷 AI Agent Protocols: The 2026 Stack

### **MCP (Model Context Protocol) — The Agent-to-Tool Standard**

MCP, created by Anthropic and donated to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) in December 2025, standardizes how an AI agent connects to external tools, data sources, and services. Anthropic describes it as "a USB-C port for AI applications" — just as USB-C provides a single universal connector, MCP provides a single universal protocol for connecting any AI application to any external tool or data source.

By February 2026, MCP has crossed 97 million monthly SDK downloads (Python + TypeScript combined) and has been adopted by every major AI provider: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Amazon. Before MCP, if you had 10 AI tools and 20 services, you needed 200 integrations (an M×N problem). MCP reduces this to an M+N problem: each AI tool implements MCP client support once, and each service implements an MCP server once.

### **A2A (Agent-to-Agent Protocol) — The Inter-Agent Standard**

A2A, created by Google in April 2025 and donated to the Linux Foundation in June 2025, standardizes how AI agents discover, communicate, and collaborate with each other — regardless of their underlying framework. IBM's Agent Communication Protocol (ACP) merged into A2A in August 2025, and in December 2025 the Linux Foundation launched the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) — co-founded by OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft, AWS, and Block — as the permanent home for both A2A and MCP.

They solve completely different problems: MCP handles how an agent talks to tools; A2A handles how agents talk to each other.

### **The Expanding Protocol Alphabet Soup**

All the protocols are trying to standardize how AI agents communicate, with the main distinction being what they're trying to talk to.
